Here’s a mix of classics, modern hits, and hidden gems you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|---|-------|------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | A masterclass in psychological dread, with iconic imagery and an unforgettable score. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | A chilling family saga that blends supernatural terror with raw emotional trauma. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | A smart social thriller that uses horror tropes to explore race and identity. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Suspense built on silence; a tense survival story with strong performances. |
| 5 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | A daylight nightmare—sunlit horror that subverts expectations and delivers a haunting atmosphere. |
| 6 | **It Follows** | 2014 | A fresh take on the “invisible stalker” trope, with a creepy soundtrack and unsettling visuals. |
| 7 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | A well‑crafted paranormal investigation that balances scares with character depth. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Psychological horror that turns grief into a literal monster, with a powerful performance by Essie Davis. |
| 9 | **Suspiria (1977)** | 1977 | Dario Argento’s surreal, color‑driven masterpiece that feels like a living painting. |
|10 | **The Witch** | 2015 | A slow‑burn, period‑accurate horror that builds dread through atmosphere and tension. |
|11 | **The Ring** | 2002 | A modern retelling of a Japanese legend that introduced the “cursed videotape” trope to Hollywood. |
|12 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Found‑footage style that makes the supernatural feel immediate and personal. |
|13 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | A meta‑commentary on horror clichés that delivers both laughs and genuine scares. |
|14 | **M3GAN** | 2023 | A contemporary AI‑robot horror that taps into our tech anxieties while delivering solid chills. |
|15 | **The Others** | 2001 | A gothic mystery with a twist that keeps you guessing until the very end. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you want a psychological thriller, supernatural chills, or something that plays with genre conventions. Happy watching!
